subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1) "willingly."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **blank needs an adverb** that describes the manner in which someone might give up their possessions under certain circumstances, particularly to emphasize readiness or without reluctance.
 
• "**Willingly**" means doing something readily, voluntarily, or without needing to be forced, which fits the context of being prepared to give up everything one owns, in this case, to save one’s life.
 
• The **passage** **discusses** the complexities in valuing services, and this sentence emphasizes the emotional and situational factors that further complicate this valuation, making "willingly" the most suitable choice.

Therefore, the **correct** **answer** is- **Option 1) "willingly**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2) "**thoroughly**" means in a thorough manner, covering every aspect, which does not directly relate to the willingness or readiness to act.
 
• Option 3) "**perfectly**" means in a manner that is completely suitable, accurate, or correct, which does not convey the sense of readiness or voluntariness.
 
• Option 4) "**thoughtfully**" means in a way that shows careful consideration or attention, which misses the emphasis on the readiness to give everything without reluctance.
